dedupe_keys.name: retaining wall on state owned roads

description: Retaining Wall (on State Owned Roads) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Tasmania Government's The List Data. This is the authoritative spatial dataset used in the administration and management of retaining walls by the Department of State Growth. It records the location of retaining walls with proximity to the 'State Government Proclaimed Road' network. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Tasmania Government's The List Data. Its tags are TRANSPORTATION-Land. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
